# 1. Executive Status
The canonical corpus is structurally strong but **cannot be called “MUKAMMAL YOPILDI” under the requested visual-fidelity standard**. Production contains 130 canonical QPs and 130 canonical MS files, 2773 unique scoring leaves, 1110 distinct question assets and 1330 paper-specific asset occurrences. Database integrity checks in this audit found 0 dangling content asset references, 0 cross-source asset references, 0 asset rows without source_page, 0 crop errors and 0 unresolved validation_findings. Those are positive structural signals, **not visual proof**.

The release blocker is evidence: every current visual still needs source-page geometry/content comparison and all four product surfaces need literal proof. Consequently this audit records **VF-5 for all 1330 paper-specific visual/structured-asset occurrences** until evidence is attached. No blanket VF-0/VF-1 is issued.

# 3. Methodology
1. Re-established canonical source inventory from production `source_papers`, not from old READY labels.
2. Rebuilt the visual register from every canonical `question_assets` row and every official `question_source_occurrences` mapping, so exact-equivalent paper occurrences remain visible.
3. Cross-checked `content_json.blocks[type=asset]` references against asset IDs and source ownership.
4. Inspected current render/export/live code paths on main SHA b65175501d0a08c36d76d9b69502b4e636601eef.
5. Applied a fail-closed fidelity rule: metadata/renderability is structural evidence only. Literal source-page vs actual rendered surface proof is required for VF-0/VF-1.
6. Where literal visual proof is absent, classification is VF-5 and an exact verification action is generated.
7. No production mutation or silent repair was performed.

**Evidence limitation that controls the final status:** the production asset bucket is private and this audit run did not obtain a complete literal rendered corpus for Question Bank, generated PDF, generated DOCX and Live Challenge. Original Drive source identity is available, but source page inspection + rendered-output capture was not completed for every element. This is an audit finding, not a pass.

# 4. Definition of Perfect Visual Fidelity
VF-0 requires semantic equivalence and source-faithful geometry/layout: correct text, rows/columns, merged cells, borders, labels, connectors, arrows, proportions, ordering, code indentation, image crop/aspect, mathematical layout, and no clipping or ambiguity. VF-1 permits only negligible cosmetic difference. VF-2 is semantically correct but visibly unlike Cambridge. VF-3 is a meaningful fidelity defect. VF-4 is missing/broken/wrong/unreadable. VF-5 means evidence is insufficient to decide. A question is PERFECT only when every required visual/context element is VF-0 or justified VF-1.

# 11. PDF Export Fidelity
Code inspection confirms a real pipeline exists: portable snapshots feed `backend/src/lib/assignment-export.ts`; private PNG assets are signed/fetched and wrapped as self-contained SVG in `backend/src/lib/export-assets.ts`; structured content is rendered through `backend/src/lib/export-html.ts`. The code also fails closed for unavailable structured assets. **No literal corpus-wide PDF output was rendered and visually compared in this audit**, so PDF status is VF-5 for every active element. Required closure evidence: source crop + generated PDF page screenshot/diff for every visual class and every repaired defect.

# 12. DOCX Export Fidelity
`backend/src/lib/export-docx.ts` contains dedicated Word table generation and SVG DrawingML embedding with aspect-ratio preservation. That is code-path evidence only. No corpus-wide Word render was visually compared to Cambridge source in this audit. DOCX remains VF-5 for active elements. Particular risks to test: SVG compatibility, Word table widths/merged-cell semantics, code wrapping, page breaks, image size/aspect, and equation/Boolean notation.

# 13. Question Bank Fidelity
Current main has a structured renderer with KaTeX and semantic HTML tables in `frontend/src/lib/structured-question-renderer.ts`, plus asset recovery/fallback logic in `frontend/src/lib/question-asset-fidelity-dom.ts`. This is implementation evidence, not visual proof. Literal desktop/mobile screenshots were not produced for all elements; Question Bank remains VF-5 per active element.

# 14. Live Challenge Fidelity
`backend/src/services/live-exam-service.ts` freezes immutable question and mark-scheme snapshots. Stored snapshots deliberately null live asset URLs and later rely on signing/resolution. That is the right architectural direction, but this audit did not open every asset in a real Live session. All active elements remain Live VF-5. Mark-scheme snapshots currently store guidance/points/groups, not a dedicated MS visual asset register, so visual answer material requires special attention.

No active asset meets the strict raster-only reproducible candidate rule. This does **not** prove every existing raster choice is optimal; visual source review is still required.

# 18. Defect Register
These are **verified audit defects/gaps**, not invented visual mismatches:

| Defect ID | Severity | Scope | Evidence | Exact defect | Exact fix | Affected surfaces | Regression |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VF-P0-0001 | P0 | 1330 asset occurrences | No literal source/render evidence attached | Current READY/renderable state cannot prove visual fidelity | Build per-element source/render proof harness and close every VF-5 | All | Source-vs-render evidence row required |
| VF-P0-0002 | P0 | PDF | Export code exists, literal corpus output not inspected | PDF fidelity not proven | Generate visual-heavy + repaired corpus PDF set; rasterize and compare | PDF | PDF screenshot/pixel/geometry diff |
| VF-P0-0003 | P0 | DOCX | DOCX generator exists, literal Word rendering not inspected | DOCX fidelity not proven | Generate DOCX, render with supported Word/LibreOffice CI, compare | DOCX | DOCX page render diff |
| VF-P0-0004 | P0 | Question Bank | Renderer code exists, no complete browser capture | Browser fidelity not proven | Playwright capture desktop/mobile for all asset classes + repaired IDs | Question Bank | Visual regression snapshots |
| VF-P0-0005 | P0 | Live Challenge | Snapshot/signing architecture exists, no complete live capture | Live fidelity not proven | Create deterministic visual test session and capture student/teacher views | Live | Live screenshot regression |
| VF-P0-0006 | P0 | Mark schemes | No dedicated MS visual provenance registry; cue scan=702 | Source MS visual completeness cannot be proven from DB | Page-by-page MS inventory; add MS visual provenance/asset model where needed | MS PDF/DOCX/Live reveal | MS source-page regression |
| VF-P1-0001 | P1 | 307 assets | ref_count=0 | Dormant/orphan/replacement intent is not normalized | Reconcile replacement chains; retain source-proof crops; archive true stale rows | DB/exports | zero consumer references before archive |
| VF-P1-0002 | P1-VERIFY | 382 refs | same-source cross-question references | Likely shared parent/context, but ownership/order needs explicit proof | Verify ancestor/dependency ownership and snapshot order | QB/PDF/DOCX/Live | context-order regression |

# 19. P0 Work
1. Implement the evidence harness and data contract before claiming any VF-0/VF-1.
2. Run literal page-by-page QP and MS source inventory.
3. Capture current Question Bank, PDF, DOCX and Live output for every active asset class and all high-risk elements.
4. Replace each active VF-5 with VF-0/VF-1 or a concrete VF-2/3/4 defect; no unresolved VF-5 may remain at final closure.

# 20. P1 Work
Reconcile 307 dormant assets; verify 382 shared/cross-question refs; convert only source-proven reproducible raster visuals; implement MS visual provenance; repair every discovered VF-3 and any fidelity-relevant VF-2.

# 21. P2 Work
After semantic fidelity is proven: spacing, Cambridge-like proportions, typography, cell padding, line weights, page-break aesthetics, responsive scaling and projector/mobile polish.

# 22. P3 Work
Optional tooling enrichment only after closure: visual-diff dashboard, reviewer UI, source/render side-by-side gallery, auto-generated evidence thumbnails and historical asset lineage visualization.

# 23. Exact Implementation Plan
- **Database:** add a durable visual-evidence ledger keyed by source paper/question/asset/surface; add a mark-scheme visual provenance model if MS page audit confirms visuals not representable by existing mark-point text.
- **Source extraction:** add `backend/scripts/9618-visual-fidelity-audit.py` (or equivalent) to render exact source page/bbox from SHA-matched PDFs, never OCR-guess when pixels are available.
- **Question Bank:** extend tests around `frontend/src/lib/structured-question-renderer.ts` and `frontend/src/lib/question-asset-fidelity-dom.ts`.
- **PDF:** extend `backend/src/lib/export-html.ts`, `backend/src/lib/export-assets.ts` and export E2E tests only when a concrete source mismatch is found.
- **DOCX:** extend `backend/src/lib/export-docx.ts` with regression fixtures for any discovered Word-specific defect.
- **Live:** extend `backend/src/services/live-exam-service.ts` and live UI visual tests for snapshot asset ordering/signing and MS visual reveal.
- **Audit SQL:** extend `backend/src/database/audits/past-paper-source-fidelity-v2.sql` / 9618 release audits to require evidence-ledger closure, not only renderability.

# 24. Migration Plan
No production migration was applied by this audit. Next implementation should use the **next available migration number after current main/production reconciliation**, never hard-code a conflicting number. Proposed schema:

- `visual_fidelity_evidence(id, source_paper_id, question_id, asset_id, surface, source_page, source_bbox, source_sha256, rendered_sha256, classification, evidence_path, verifier, verified_at, notes)`.
- Optional `mark_scheme_assets` / `mark_scheme_visual_evidence` only if source MS audit demonstrates a real need; do not create redundant schema without source evidence.
- Migration must be additive first, backfilled from verified evidence, and fail closed. No question text/marks/taxonomy rewrite is part of visual repair unless source contradiction independently proves it.

# 25. Code Change Plan
Target paths: `backend/scripts/`, `backend/src/database/audits/`, `backend/src/lib/export-html.ts`, `backend/src/lib/export-assets.ts`, `backend/src/lib/export-docx.ts`, `backend/src/services/live-exam-service.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/structured-question-renderer.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/question-asset-fidelity-dom.ts`, and focused visual-regression tests. # 26. Regression Tests Required
For each repaired defect class: exact source fixture; source SHA assertion; asset owner/page assertion; renderer snapshot; browser screenshot; PDF render check; DOCX render check; Live snapshot/view check; mark-scheme reveal check when applicable; no dangling/cross-source refs; no asset loss through portable snapshot.

# 27. Re-render / Re-export Verification Plan
For every active visual: (1) render source page/bbox at fixed DPI, (2) render canonical asset, (3) capture QB desktop/mobile, (4) generate PDF and rasterize target page, (5) generate DOCX and rasterize with controlled office renderer, (6) run Live session and capture learner/teacher views, (7) compare semantic labels/counts/order plus geometry, (8) store evidence and classification. A visual can be VF-0/VF-1 only after all mandatory surfaces pass.

# 28. Final Closure SQL / Audit Requirements
Final release gate must return zero for: unresolved VF-3, VF-4, unexplained VF-5, missing referenced assets, cross-source accidental refs, source_page/SHA gaps, invalid/unrenderable required SVG/LaTeX, PDF critical failures, DOCX critical failures, Question Bank critical failures, Live critical failures, and unverified required MS visuals. It must also prove every canonical QP/MS source row has a completed page-level audit and every active asset has mandatory surface evidence.

Existing structural values at this audit point: dangling_refs=0; cross_source_refs=0; source_page gaps=0; crop_errors=0; structured scoring blockers=0; LaTeX scoring blockers=0.

# 29. Final Definition of Done
Do **not** write “MUKAMMAL YOPILDI” until: every canonical QP is page-audited; every relevant MS visual is page-audited; every visual is inventoried with source provenance; no VF-4; no unresolved VF-3; no unexplained VF-5; VF-2 is fixed or explicitly accepted; critical failures are zero on PDF/DOCX/QB/Live; raster/code and source-image-required registers are source-proven; regression tests exist; final closure audit passes on production-equivalent data.
